[comment by filloax (none)]
After grueling investigation, I can confirm that this only seems to happen with the `atomicfu` plugin enabled in Gradle (regardless of using any of its classes). Changing to another plugin for now, but to note that this doesn't happen on Fabric with Fabric Language Kotlin, so it's likely a conflict of some sort.

[comment by RubixDev (none)]
I get the same error with kff 5.9.0 and Minecraft 1.20.6 with NeoForge 20.6.139, and I don't have the `atomicfu` plugin configured (at least not manually). I have not yet found a fix for this. Of note is also, that building the mod and using it in a normal Minecraft instance works fine, it's only broken in the dev environment.
